ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّ زَلْزَلَةَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ شَىْءٌ عَظِيمٌ
en: (1) O mankind, fear your Lord. Indeed, the convulsion of the [final] Hour is a terrible thing.
tr: Yā ayyuhan-nāsuttaqū rabbakum, inna zalzalatas-sāʿati shayʾun ʿaẓīm

ar: يَوْمَ تَرَوْنَهَا تَذْهَلُ كُلُّ مُرْضِعَةٍ عَمَّآ أَرْضَعَتْ وَتَضَعُ كُلُّ ذَاتِ حَمْلٍ حَمْلَهَا وَتَرَى ٱلنَّاسَ سُكَٰرَىٰ وَمَا هُم بِسُكَٰرَىٰ وَلَٰكِنَّ عَذَابَ ٱللَّهِ شَدِيدٌ
en: (2) On the Day you see it every nursing mother will be distracted from that [child] she was nursing, and every pregnant woman will abort her pregnancy, and you will see the people [appearing] intoxicated while they are not intoxicated; but the punishment of Allāh is severe.
tr: Yawma tarawnahā tadhhalu kullu murḍiʿatin ʿammā arḍaʿat wataḍaʿu kullu dhāti ḥamlin ḥamlahā wataran-nāsa sukārā wamā hum bisukārā walākinna ʿadhāballāhi shadīd

ar: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَٰدِلُ فِى ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَيَتَّبِعُ كُلَّ شَيْطَٰنٍ مَّرِيدٍ
en: (3) And of the people is he who disputes about Allāh without knowledge and follows every rebellious devil.
tr: Waminan-nāsi may yujādilu fillāhi bighayri ʿilmiw wayattabiʿu kulla shayṭānim marīd

ar: كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِ أَنَّهُۥ مَن تَوَلَّاهُ فَأَنَّهُۥ يُضِلُّهُۥ وَيَهْدِيهِ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
en: (4) It has been decreed for him [i.e., every devil] that whoever turns to him - he will misguide him and will lead him to the punishment of the Blaze.
tr: Kutiba ʿalayhi annahū man tawallāhu faʾannahū yuḍilluhū wayahdīhi ilā ʿadhābis-saʿīr

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِن كُنتُمْ فِى رَيْبٍ مِّنَ ٱلْبَعْثِ فَإِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ مِن مُّضْغَةٍ مُّخَلَّقَةٍ وَغَيْرِ مُخَلَّقَةٍ لِّنُبَيِّنَ لَكُمْ وَنُقِرُّ فِى ٱلْأَرْحَامِ مَا نَشَآءُ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ثُمَّ نُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوٓا۟ أَشُدَّكُمْ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُتَوَفَّىٰ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرْذَلِ ٱلْعُمُرِ لِكَيْلَا يَعْلَمَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ عِلْمٍ شَيْـًٔا وَتَرَى ٱلْأَرْضَ هَامِدَةً فَإِذَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا ٱلْمَآءَ ٱهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ وَأَنۢبَتَتْ مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍ
en: (5) O people, if you should be in doubt about the Resurrection, then [consider that] indeed, We created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot, and then from a lump of flesh, formed and unformed[915] - that We may show you.[916] And We settle in the wombs whom We will for a specified term, then We bring you out as a child, and then [We develop you] that you may reach your [time of] maturity. And among you is he who is taken in [early] death, and among you is he who is returned to the most decrepit [old] age so that he knows, after [once having] knowledge, nothing. And you see the earth barren, but when We send down upon it rain, it quivers and swells and grows [something] of every beautiful kind.
enNotes:
[915]- That which is incomplete. This may include what is aborted at that stage.
[916]- Our power and creative ability.
tr: Yā ayyuhan-nāsu in kuntum fī raybim minal-baʿthi faʾinnā khalaqnākum min turābin thumma min nuṭfatin thumma min ʿalaqatin thumma mim muḍghatim mukhallaqatiw waghayri mukhallaqatil linubayyina lakum, wanuqirru fil-arḥāmi mā nashāʾu ilā ajalim musamman thumma nukhrijukum ṭiflan thumma litablughū ashuddakum, waminkum may yutawaffā waminkum may yuraddu ilā ardhalil-ʿumuri likaylā yaʿlama mim baʿdi ʿilmin shayʾā, wataral-arḍa hāmidatan faʾidhā anzalnā ʿalayhal-māʾahtazzat warabat waʾambatat min kulli zawjim bahīj

ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنَّهُۥ يُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَأَنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
en: (6) That is because Allāh is the True Reality and because He gives life to the dead and because He is over all things competent
tr: Dhālika biʾannallāha huwal-ḥaqqu waʾannahū yuḥyil-mawtā waʾannahū ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr

ar: وَأَنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهَا وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبْعَثُ مَن فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
en: (7) And [that they may know] that the Hour is coming - no doubt about it - and that Allāh will resurrect those in the graves.
tr: Waʾannas-sāʿata ātiyatul lā rayba fīhā waʾannallāha yabʿathu man fil-qubūr

ar: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَٰدِلُ فِى ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَلَا هُدًى وَلَا كِتَٰبٍ مُّنِيرٍ
en: (8) And of the people is he who disputes about Allāh without knowledge or guidance or an enlightening book [from Him],
tr: Waminan-nāsi may yujādilu fillāhi bighayri ʿilmiw walā hudaw walā kitābim munīr

ar: ثَانِىَ عِطْفِهِۦ لِيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُۥ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا خِزْىٌ وَنُذِيقُهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ عَذَابَ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
en: (9) Twisting his neck [in arrogance] to mislead [people] from the way of Allāh. For him in the world is disgrace, and We will make him taste on the Day of Resurrection the punishment of the Burning Fire [while it is said],
tr: Thāniya ʿiṭfihī liyuḍilla ʿan sabīlillāh, lahū fid-dunyā khizyuw wanudhīquhū yawmal-qiyāmati ʿadhābal-ḥarīq

ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاكَ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
en: (10) "That is for what your hands have put forth and because Allāh is not ever unjust to [His] servants."
tr: Dhālika bimā qaddamat yadāka waʾannallāha laysa biẓallāmil lil-ʿabīd

ar: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَعْبُدُ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ حَرْفٍ فَإِنْ أَصَابَهُۥ خَيْرٌ ٱطْمَأَنَّ بِهِۦ وَإِنْ أَصَابَتْهُ فِتْنَةٌ ٱنقَلَبَ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦ خَسِرَ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْخُسْرَانُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
en: (11) And of the people is he who worships Allāh on an edge.[917] If he is touched by good, he is reassured by it; but if he is struck by trial, he turns on his face [to unbelief]. He has lost [this] world and the Hereafter. That is what is the manifest loss.
enNotes: [917]- At the edge of his religion, so to speak, i.e., with uncertainty, hypocrisy or heedlessness.
tr: Waminan-nāsi may yaʿbudullāha ʿalā ḥarf, faʾin aṣābahū khayruniṭmaʾanna bih, waʾin aṣābathu fitnatuninqalaba ʿalā wajhih, khasirad-dunyā wal-ākhirah, dhālika huwal-khusrānul-mubīn

ar: يَدْعُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَضُرُّهُۥ وَمَا لَا يَنفَعُهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلضَّلَٰلُ ٱلْبَعِيدُ
en: (12) He invokes instead of Allāh that which neither harms him nor benefits him. That is what is the extreme error.
tr: Yadʿū min dūnillāhi mā lā yaḍurruhū wamā lā yanfaʿuh, dhālika huwaḍ-ḍalālul-baʿīd

ar: يَدْعُوا۟ لَمَن ضَرُّهُۥٓ أَقْرَبُ مِن نَّفْعِهِۦ لَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَوْلَىٰ وَلَبِئْسَ ٱلْعَشِيرُ
en: (13) He invokes one whose harm is closer than his benefit - how wretched the protector and how wretched the associate.
tr: Yadʿū laman ḍarruhū aqrabu min nafʿih, labiʾsal-mawlā walabiʾsal-ʿashīr

ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يُرِيدُ
en: (14) Indeed, Allāh will admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow. Indeed, Allāh does what He intends.
tr: Innallāha yudkhilul-ladhīna āmanū waʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti jannātin tajrī min taḥtihal-anhār, innallāha yafʿalu mā yurīd

ar: مَن كَانَ يَظُنُّ أَن لَّن يَنصُرَهُ ٱللَّهُ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ بِسَبَبٍ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ ثُمَّ لْيَقْطَعْ فَلْيَنظُرْ هَلْ يُذْهِبَنَّ كَيْدُهُۥ مَا يَغِيظُ
en: (15) Whoever should think that Allāh will not support him [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] in this world and the Hereafter - let him extend a rope to the ceiling, then cut off [his breath],[918] and let him see: will his effort remove that which enrages [him]?
enNotes: [918]- i.e., strangle himself.
tr: Man kāna yaẓunnu al lay yanṣurahullāhu fid-dunyā wal-ākhirati falyamdud bisababin ilas-samāʾi thumma lyaqṭaʿ falyanẓur hal yudhhibanna kayduhū mā yaghīẓ

ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ ءَايَٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَٰتٍ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَهْدِى مَن يُرِيدُ
en: (16) And thus have We sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down as verses of clear evidence and because Allāh guides whom He intends.
tr: Wakadhālika anzalnāhu āyātim bayyinātiw waʾannallāha yahdī may yurīd

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ وَٱلصَّٰبِـِٔينَ وَٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ وَٱلْمَجُوسَ وَٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
en: (17) Indeed, those who have believed and those who were Jews and the Sabeans and the Christians and the Magians and those who associated with Allāh - Allāh will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allāh is, over all things, Witness.[919]
enNotes: [919]- See footnote of 4:79.
tr: Innal-ladhīna āmanū wal-ladhīna hādū waṣ-ṣābiʾīna wan-naṣārā wal-majūsa wal-ladhīna ashrakū, innallāha yafṣilu baynahum yawmal-qiyāmah, innallāha ʿalā kulli shayʾin shahīd

ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَسْجُدُ لَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ وَٱلنُّجُومُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ وَٱلدَّوَآبُّ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَكَثِيرٌ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْعَذَابُ وَمَن يُهِنِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن مُّكْرِمٍ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ
en: (18) Do you not see [i.e., know] that to Allāh prostrates whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth and the sun, the moon, the stars, the mountains, the trees, the moving creatures and many of the people? But upon many the punishment has been justified.[920] And he whom Allāh humiliates - for him there is no bestower of honor. Indeed, Allāh does what He wills.
enNotes: [920]- And therefore decreed.
tr: Alam tara annallāha yasjudu lahū man fis-samāwāti waman fil-arḍi wash-shamsu wal-qamaru wan-nujūmu wal-jibālu wash-shajaru wad-dawābbu wakathīrum minan-nās, wakathīrun ḥaqqa ʿalayhil-ʿadhāb, wamay yuhinillāhu famā lahū mim mukrim, innallāha yafʿalu mā yashāʾ

ar: هَٰذَانِ خَصْمَانِ ٱخْتَصَمُوا۟ فِى رَبِّهِمْ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ قُطِّعَتْ لَهُمْ ثِيَابٌ مِّن نَّارٍ يُصَبُّ مِن فَوْقِ رُءُوسِهِمُ ٱلْحَمِيمُ
en: (19) These[921] are two adversaries who have disputed over their Lord. But those who disbelieved will have cut out for them garments of fire. Poured upon their heads will be scalding water
enNotes: [921]- i.e., the believers and the disbelievers.
tr: Hādhāni khaṣmānikhtaṣamū fī rabbihim fal-ladhīna kafarū quṭṭiʿat lahum thiyābum min nār, yuṣabbu min fawqi ruʾūsihimul-ḥamīm

ar: يُصْهَرُ بِهِۦ مَا فِى بُطُونِهِمْ وَٱلْجُلُودُ
en: (20) By which is melted that within their bellies and [their] skins.
tr: Yuṣharu bihī mā fī buṭūnihim wal-julūd

ar: وَلَهُم مَّقَٰمِعُ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ
en: (21) And for [striking] them are maces of iron.
tr: Walahum maqāmiʿu min ḥadīd

ar: كُلَّمَآ أَرَادُوٓا۟ أَن يَخْرُجُوا۟ مِنْهَا مِنْ غَمٍّ أُعِيدُوا۟ فِيهَا وَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
en: (22) Every time they want to get out of it [i.e., Hellfire] from anguish, they will be returned to it, and [it will be said], "Taste the punishment of the Burning Fire!"
tr: Kullamā arādū ay yakhrujū minhā min ghammin uʿīdū fīhā wadhūqū ʿadhābal-ḥarīq

ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍ وَلُؤْلُؤًا وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌ
en: (23) Indeed, Allāh will admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and pearl, and their garments therein will be silk.
tr: Innallāha yudkhilul-ladhīna āmanū waʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti jannātin tajrī min taḥtihal-anhāru yuḥallawna fīhā min asāwira min dhahabiw waluʾluʾā, walibāsuhum fīhā ḥarīr

ar: وَهُدُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيِّبِ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَهُدُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
en: (24) And they had been guided [in worldly life] to good speech, and they were guided to the path of the Praiseworthy.
tr: Wahudū ilaṭ-ṭayyibi minal-qawl, wahudū ilā ṣirāṭil-ḥamīd

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلْنَٰهُ لِلنَّاسِ سَوَآءً ٱلْعَٰكِفُ فِيهِ وَٱلْبَادِ وَمَن يُرِدْ فِيهِ بِإِلْحَادٍۭ بِظُلْمٍ نُّذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
en: (25) Indeed, those who have disbelieved and avert [people] from the way of Allāh and [from] al-Masjid al-Ḥarām, which We made for the people - equal are the resident therein and one from outside - and [also] whoever intends [a deed] therein[922] of deviation [in religion] by wrongdoing - We will make him taste of a painful punishment.
enNotes: [922]- Whether inside its boundaries or intending from afar to do evil therein. The Ḥaram is unique in that the mere intention of sin therein (whether or not it is actually carried out) is sufficient to bring punishment from Allāh.
tr: Innal-ladhīna kafarū wayaṣuddūna ʿan sabīlillāhi wal-masjidil-ḥarāmil-ladhī jaʿalnāhu lin-nāsi sawāʾanil-ʿākifu fīhi wal-bād, wamay yurid fīhi biʾilḥādim biẓulmin nudhiqhu min ʿadhābin alīm

ar: وَإِذْ بَوَّأْنَا لِإِبْرَٰهِيمَ مَكَانَ ٱلْبَيْتِ أَن لَّا تُشْرِكْ بِى شَيْـًٔا وَطَهِّرْ بَيْتِىَ لِلطَّآئِفِينَ وَٱلْقَآئِمِينَ وَٱلرُّكَّعِ ٱلسُّجُودِ
en: (26) And [mention, O Muḥammad], when We designated for Abraham the site of the House, [saying], "Do not associate anything with Me and purify My House for those who perform ṭawāf[923] and those who stand [in prayer] and those who bow and prostrate.
enNotes: [923]- See footnote to 2:125.
tr: Waʾidh bawwaʾnā liʾibrāhīma makānal-bayti al lā tushrik bī shayʾaw waṭahhir baytiya liṭ-ṭāʾifīna wal-qāʾimīna war-rukkaʿis-sujūd

ar: وَأَذِّن فِى ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَجِّ يَأْتُوكَ رِجَالًا وَعَلَىٰ كُلِّ ضَامِرٍ يَأْتِينَ مِن كُلِّ فَجٍّ عَمِيقٍ
en: (27) And proclaim to the people the ḥajj [pilgrimage]; they will come to you on foot and on every lean camel; they will come from every distant pass -
tr: Waʾadhdhin fin-nāsi bil-ḥajji yaʾtūka rijālaw waʿalā kulli ḍāmiriy yaʾtīna min kulli fajjin ʿamīq

ar: لِّيَشْهَدُوا۟ مَنَٰفِعَ لَهُمْ وَيَذْكُرُوا۟ ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ فِىٓ أَيَّامٍ مَّعْلُومَٰتٍ عَلَىٰ مَا رَزَقَهُم مِّنۢ بَهِيمَةِ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ فَكُلُوا۟ مِنْهَا وَأَطْعِمُوا۟ ٱلْبَآئِسَ ٱلْفَقِيرَ
en: (28) That they may witness [i.e., attend] benefits for themselves and mention the name of Allāh on known [i.e., specific] days over what He has provided for them of [sacrificial] animals.[924] So eat of them and feed the miserable and poor.
enNotes: [924]- Al-anʿām: camels, cattle, sheep and goats.
tr: Liyashhadū manāfiʿa lahum wayadhkurusmallāhi fī ayyāmim maʿlūmātin ʿalā mā razaqahum mim bahīmatil-anʿām, fakulū minhā waʾaṭʿimul-bāʾisal-faqīr

ar: ثُمَّ لْيَقْضُوا۟ تَفَثَهُمْ وَلْيُوفُوا۟ نُذُورَهُمْ وَلْيَطَّوَّفُوا۟ بِٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْعَتِيقِ
en: (29) Then let them end their untidiness and fulfill their vows and perform ṭawāf around the ancient House."
tr: Thumma lyaqḍū tafathahum walyūfū nudhūrahum walyaṭṭawwafū bil-baytil-ʿatīq

ar: ذَٰلِكَ وَمَن يُعَظِّمْ حُرُمَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ وَأُحِلَّتْ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمُ إِلَّا مَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ ٱلرِّجْسَ مِنَ ٱلْأَوْثَٰنِ وَٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ قَوْلَ ٱلزُّورِ
en: (30) That [has been commanded], and whoever honors the sacred ordinances of Allāh - it is best for him in the sight of his Lord. And permitted to you are the grazing livestock, except what is recited to you.[925] So avoid the uncleanliness of idols and avoid false statement,
tr: Dhālika wamay yuʿaẓẓim ḥurumātillāhi fahuwa khayrul lahū ʿinda rabbih, waʾuḥillat lakumul-anʿāmu illā mā yutlā ʿalaykum fajtanibur-rijsa minal-awthāni wajtanibū qawlaz-zūr

ar: حُنَفَآءَ لِلَّهِ غَيْرَ مُشْرِكِينَ بِهِۦ وَمَن يُشْرِكْ بِٱللَّهِ فَكَأَنَّمَا خَرَّ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَتَخْطَفُهُ ٱلطَّيْرُ أَوْ تَهْوِى بِهِ ٱلرِّيحُ فِى مَكَانٍ سَحِيقٍ
en: (31) Inclining [only] to Allāh, not associating [anything] with Him. And he who associates with Allāh - it is as though he had fallen from the sky and was snatched by the birds or the wind carried him down into a remote place.
tr: Ḥunafāʾa lillāhi ghayra mushrikīna bih, wamay yushrik billāhi fakaʾannamā kharra minas-samāʾi fatakhṭafuhuṭ-ṭayru aw tahwī bihir-rīḥu fī makānin saḥīq

ar: ذَٰلِكَ وَمَن يُعَظِّمْ شَعَٰٓئِرَ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّهَا مِن تَقْوَى ٱلْقُلُوبِ
en: (32) That [is so]. And whoever honors the symbols [i.e., rites] of Allāh - indeed, it is from the piety of hearts.
tr: Dhālika wamay yuʿaẓẓim shaʿāʾirallāhi faʾinnahā min taqwal-qulūb

ar: لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ثُمَّ مَحِلُّهَآ إِلَى ٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْعَتِيقِ
en: (33) For you therein [i.e., the animals marked for sacrifice] are benefits for a specified term;[926] then their place of sacrifice is at the ancient House.[927]
enNotes:
[926]- i.e., they may be milked or ridden (in the case of camels) before the time of slaughter.
[927]- i.e., within the boundaries of the Ḥaram, which includes Minā.
tr: Lakum fīhā manāfiʿu ilā ajalim musamman thumma maḥilluhā ilal-baytil-ʿatīq

ar: وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ جَعَلْنَا مَنسَكًا لِّيَذْكُرُوا۟ ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَىٰ مَا رَزَقَهُم مِّنۢ بَهِيمَةِ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ فَإِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ فَلَهُۥٓ أَسْلِمُوا۟ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُخْبِتِينَ
en: (34) And for every [religious] community We have appointed a rite [of sacrifice][928] that they may mention the name of Allāh over what He has provided for them of [sacrificial] animals. For your god is one God, so to Him submit. And, [O Muḥammad], give good tidings to the humble [before their Lord]
enNotes: [928]- i.e., the rite of sacrifice has always been a part of Allāh's revealed religion.
tr: Walikulli ummatin jaʿalnā mansakal liyadhkurusmallāhi ʿalā mā razaqahum mim bahīmatil-anʿām, faʾilāhukum ilāhuw wāḥidun falahū aslimū, wabashshiril-mukhbitīn

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَصَابَهُمْ وَٱلْمُقِيمِى ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
en: (35) Who, when Allāh is mentioned, their hearts are fearful, and [to] the patient over what has afflicted them, and the establishers of prayer and those who spend from what We have provided them.
tr: Al-ladhīna idhā dhukirallāhu wajilat qulūbuhum waṣ-ṣābirīna ʿalā mā aṣābahum wal-muqīmiṣ-ṣalāti wamimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūn

ar: وَٱلْبُدْنَ جَعَلْنَٰهَا لَكُم مِّن شَعَٰٓئِرِ ٱللَّهِ لَكُمْ فِيهَا خَيْرٌ فَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا صَوَآفَّ فَإِذَا وَجَبَتْ جُنُوبُهَا فَكُلُوا۟ مِنْهَا وَأَطْعِمُوا۟ ٱلْقَانِعَ وَٱلْمُعْتَرَّ كَذَٰلِكَ سَخَّرْنَٰهَا لَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
en: (36) And the camels and cattle We have appointed for you as among the symbols [i.e., rites] of Allāh; for you therein is good. So mention the name of Allāh upon them when lined up [for sacrifice]; and when they are [lifeless] on their sides, then eat from them and feed the needy [who does not seek aid] and the beggar. Thus have We subjected them to you that you may be grateful.
tr: Wal-budna jaʿalnāhā lakum min shaʿāʾirillāhi lakum fīhā khayr, fadhkurusmallāhi ʿalayhā ṣawāff, faʾidhā wajabat junūbuhā fakulū minhā waʾaṭʿimul-qāniʿa wal-muʿtarr, kadhālika sakhkharnāhā lakum laʿallakum tashkurūn

ar: لَن يَنَالَ ٱللَّهَ لُحُومُهَا وَلَا دِمَآؤُهَا وَلَٰكِن يَنَالُهُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ مِنكُمْ كَذَٰلِكَ سَخَّرَهَا لَكُمْ لِتُكَبِّرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ مَا هَدَىٰكُمْ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
en: (37) Their meat will not reach Allāh, nor will their blood, but what reaches Him is piety from you. Thus have We subjected them to you that you may glorify Allāh for that [to] which He has guided you; and give good tidings to the doers of good.
tr: Lay yanālallāha luḥūmuhā walā dimāʾuhā walākiy yanāluhut-taqwā minkum, kadhālika sakhkharahā lakum litukabbirullāha ʿalā mā hadākum, wabashshiril-muḥsinīn

ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدَٰفِعُ عَنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ خَوَّانٍ كَفُورٍ
en: (38) Indeed, Allāh defends those who have believed. Indeed, Allāh does not like everyone treacherous and ungrateful.
tr: Innallāha yudāfiʿu ʿanil-ladhīna āmanū, innallāha lā yuḥibbu kulla khawwānin kafūr

ar: أُذِنَ لِلَّذِينَ يُقَٰتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا۟ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدِيرٌ
en: (39) Permission [to fight] has been given to those who are being fought,[929] because they were wronged. And indeed, Allāh is competent to give them victory.
enNotes: [929]- Referring here to the Prophet's companions.
tr: Udhina lilladhīna yuqātalūna biʾannahum ẓulimū, waʾinnallāha ʿalā naṣrihim laqadīr

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ أُخْرِجُوا۟ مِن دِيَٰرِهِم بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ إِلَّآ أَن يَقُولُوا۟ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ وَلَوْلَا دَفْعُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلنَّاسَ بَعْضَهُم بِبَعْضٍ لَّهُدِّمَتْ صَوَٰمِعُ وَبِيَعٌ وَصَلَوَٰتٌ وَمَسَٰجِدُ يُذْكَرُ فِيهَا ٱسْمُ ٱللَّهِ كَثِيرًا وَلَيَنصُرَنَّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُۥٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَقَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ
en: (40) [They are] those who have been evicted from their homes without right - only because they say, "Our Lord is Allāh." And were it not that Allāh checks the people, some by means of others, there would have been demolished monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques in which the name of Allāh is much mentioned [i.e., praised]. And Allāh will surely support those who support Him [i.e., His cause]. Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and Exalted in Might.
tr: Al-ladhīna ukhrijū min diyārihim bighayri ḥaqqin illā ay yaqūlū rabbunallāh, walawlā dafʿullāhin-nāsa baʿḍahum bibaʿḍil lahuddimat ṣawāmiʿu wabiyaʿuw waṣalawātuw wamasājidu yudhkaru fīhasmullāhi kathīrā, walayanṣurannallāhu may yanṣuruh, innallāha laqawiyyun ʿazīz

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ إِن مَّكَّنَّٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَمَرُوا۟ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَنَهَوْا۟ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ وَلِلَّهِ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْأُمُورِ
en: (41) [And they are] those who, if We give them authority in the land, establish prayer and give zakāh and enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong. And to Allāh belongs the outcome of [all] matters.
tr: Alladhīna im makkannāhum fil-arḍi aqāmuṣ-ṣalāta waʾātawuz-zakāta waʾamarū bil-maʿrūfi wanahaw ʿanil-munkar, walillāhi ʿāqibatul-umūr

ar: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَثَمُودُ
en: (42) And if they deny you, [O Muḥammad] - so, before them, did the people of Noah and ʿAad and Thamūd deny [their prophets],
tr: Waʾiy yukadhdhibūka faqad kadhdhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥiw waʿāduw wathamūd

ar: وَقَوْمُ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ
en: (43) And the people of Abraham and the people of Lot
tr: Waqawmu ibrāhīma waqawmu lūṭ

ar: وَأَصْحَٰبُ مَدْيَنَ وَكُذِّبَ مُوسَىٰ فَأَمْلَيْتُ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهُمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
en: (44) And the inhabitants of Madyan. And Moses was denied, so I prolonged enjoyment for the disbelievers; then I seized them, and how [terrible] was My reproach.
tr: Waʾaṣḥābu madyan, wakudhdhiba mūsā faʾamlaytu lil-kāfirīna thumma akhadhtuhum, fakayfa kāna nakīr

ar: فَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَٰهَا وَهِىَ ظَالِمَةٌ فَهِىَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا وَبِئْرٍ مُّعَطَّلَةٍ وَقَصْرٍ مَّشِيدٍ
en: (45) And how many a city did We destroy while it was committing wrong - so it is [now] fallen into ruin[930] - and [how many] an abandoned well and [how many] a lofty palace.[931]
enNotes:
[930]- Literally, "fallen in upon its roofs," i.e., after the roofs of its buildings had caved in, the walls collapsed over them.
[931]- i.e., How many wells have been left inoperative, and how many palaces have been emptied of their occupants in the past.
tr: Fakaʾayyim min qaryatin ahlaknāhā wahiya ẓālimatun fahiya khāwiyatun ʿalā ʿurūshihā, wabiʾrim muʿaṭṭalatiw waqaṣrim mashīd

ar: أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَتَكُونَ لَهُمْ قُلُوبٌ يَعْقِلُونَ بِهَآ أَوْ ءَاذَانٌ يَسْمَعُونَ بِهَا فَإِنَّهَا لَا تَعْمَى ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ وَلَٰكِن تَعْمَى ٱلْقُلُوبُ ٱلَّتِى فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ
en: (46) So have they not traveled through the earth and have hearts by which to reason and ears by which to hear? For indeed, it is not eyes that are blinded, but blinded are the hearts which are within the breasts.
tr: Afalam yasīrū fil-arḍi fatakūna lahum qulūbuy yaʿqilūna bihā aw ādhānuy yasmaʿūna bihā, faʾinnahā lā taʿmal-abṣāru walākin taʿmal-qulūbul-latī fiṣ-ṣudūr

ar: وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِٱلْعَذَابِ وَلَن يُخْلِفَ ٱللَّهُ وَعْدَهُۥ وَإِنَّ يَوْمًا عِندَ رَبِّكَ كَأَلْفِ سَنَةٍ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ
en: (47) And they urge you to hasten the punishment. But Allāh will never fail in His promise. And indeed, a day with your Lord is like a thousand years of those which you count.
tr: Wayastaʿjilūnaka bil-ʿadhābi walay yukhlifallāhu waʿdah, waʾinna yawman ʿinda rabbika kaʾalfi sanatim mimmā taʿuddūn

ar: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَمْلَيْتُ لَهَا وَهِىَ ظَالِمَةٌ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهَا وَإِلَىَّ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
en: (48) And for how many a city did I prolong enjoyment while it was committing wrong. Then I seized it, and to Me is the [final] destination.
tr: Wakaʾayyim min qaryatin amlaytu lahā wahiya ẓālimatun thumma akhadhtuhā, waʾilayyal-maṣīr

ar: قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
en: (49) Say, "O people, I am only to you a clear warner."
tr: Qul yā ayyuhan-nāsu innamā ana lakum nadhīrum mubīn

ar: فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ
en: (50) And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - for them is forgiveness and noble provision.
tr: Fal-ladhīna āmanū waʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti lahum maghfiratuw warizqun karīm

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ سَعَوْا۟ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مُعَٰجِزِينَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
en: (51) But the ones who strove against Our verses, [seeking] to cause failure[932] - those are the companions of Hellfire.
enNotes: [932]- i.e., trying to undermine their credibility and thereby defeat the Prophet (ﷺ).
tr: Wal-ladhīna saʿaw fī āyātinā muʿājizīna ulāʾika aṣḥābul-jaḥīm

ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ وَلَا نَبِىٍّ إِلَّآ إِذَا تَمَنَّىٰٓ أَلْقَى ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ فِىٓ أُمْنِيَّتِهِۦ فَيَنسَخُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يُلْقِى ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ ثُمَّ يُحْكِمُ ٱللَّهُ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
en: (52) And We did not send before you any messenger or prophet except that when he spoke [or recited], Satan threw into it [some misunderstanding]. But Allāh abolishes that which Satan throws in; then Allāh makes precise His verses.[933] And Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
enNotes: [933]- Clarifying those issues which were misunderstood to remove any doubt.
tr: Wamā arsalnā min qablika mir rasūliw walā nabiyyin illā idhā tamannā alqash-shayṭānu fī umniyyatih, fayansakhullāhu mā yulqish-shayṭānu thumma yuḥkimullāhu āyātih, wallāhu ʿalīmun ḥakīm

ar: لِّيَجْعَلَ مَا يُلْقِى ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْقَاسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ لَفِى شِقَاقٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
en: (53) [That is] so He may make what Satan throws in [i.e., asserts] a trial for those within whose hearts is disease[934] and those hard of heart. And indeed, the wrongdoers are in extreme dissension.
enNotes: [934]- See footnote to 2:10.
tr: Liyajʿala mā yulqish-shayṭānu fitnatal lilladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍuw wal-qāsiyati qulūbuhum, waʾinnaẓ-ẓālimīna lafī shiqāqim baʿīd

ar: وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ أَنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَتُخْبِتَ لَهُۥ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
en: (54) And so those who were given knowledge may know that it is the truth from your Lord and [therefore] believe in it, and their hearts humbly submit to it. And indeed is Allāh the Guide of those who have believed to a straight path.
tr: Waliyaʿlamal-ladhīna ūtul-ʿilma annahul-ḥaqqu mir rabbika fayuʾminū bihī fatukhbita lahū qulūbuhum, waʾinnallāha lahādil-ladhīna āmanū ilā ṣirāṭim mustaqīm

ar: وَلَا يَزَالُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى مِرْيَةٍ مِّنْهُ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَقِيمٍ
en: (55) But those who disbelieve will not cease to be in doubt of it until the Hour comes upon them unexpectedly or there comes to them the punishment of a barren Day.[935]
enNotes: [935]- One which will not be followed by night and therefore will not give birth to a new day, referring to the Day of Resurrection.
tr: Walā yazālul-ladhīna kafarū fī miryatim minhu ḥattā taʾtiyahumus-sāʿatu baghtatan aw yaʾtiyahum ʿadhābu yawmin ʿaqīm

ar: ٱلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فِى جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
en: (56) [All] sovereignty that Day is for Allāh;[936] He will judge between them. So they who believed and did righteous deeds will be in the Gardens of Pleasure.
enNotes: [936]- None will compete with Him for authority at that time.
tr: Al-mulku yawmaʾidhil lillāh, yaḥkumu baynahum, fal-ladhīna āmanū waʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti fī jannātin-naʿīm

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ
en: (57) And they who disbelieved and denied Our signs - for those there will be a humiliating punishment.
tr: Wal-ladhīna kafarū wakadhdhabū biʾāyātinā faʾulāʾika lahum ʿadhābum muhīn

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ قُتِلُوٓا۟ أَوْ مَاتُوا۟ لَيَرْزُقَنَّهُمُ ٱللَّهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
en: (58) And those who emigrated for the cause of Allāh and then were killed or died - Allāh will surely provide for them a good provision. And indeed, it is Allāh who is the best of providers.
tr: Wal-ladhīna hājarū fī sabīlillāhi thumma qutilū aw mātū layarzuqannahumullāhu rizqan ḥasanā, waʾinnallāha lahuwa khayrur-rāziqīn

ar: لَيُدْخِلَنَّهُم مُّدْخَلًا يَرْضَوْنَهُۥ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلِيمٌ حَلِيمٌ
en: (59) He will surely cause them to enter an entrance with which they will be pleased, and indeed, Allāh is Knowing and Forbearing.
tr: Layudkhilannahum mudkhalay yarḍawnah, waʾinnallāha laʿalīmun ḥalīm

ar: ذَٰلِكَ وَمَنْ عَاقَبَ بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوقِبَ بِهِۦ ثُمَّ بُغِىَ عَلَيْهِ لَيَنصُرَنَّهُ ٱللَّهُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌ
en: (60) That [is so]. And whoever responds [to injustice] with the equivalent of that with which he was harmed and then is tyrannized - Allāh will surely aid him. Indeed, Allāh is Pardoning and Forgiving.[937]
enNotes: [937]- In spite of His ability to take vengeance. The statement contains a suggestion that the believers pardon as well.
tr: Dhālika waman ʿāqaba bimithli mā ʿūqiba bihī thumma bughiya ʿalayhi layanṣurannahullāh, innallāha laʿafuwwun ghafūr

ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
en: (61) That[938] is because Allāh causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and because Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.
enNotes: [938]- i.e., Allāh's capability to give assistance or victory to the oppressed.
tr: Dhālika biʾannallāha yūlijul-layla fin-nahāri wayūlijun-nahāra fil-layli waʾannallāha samīʿum baṣīr

ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنَّ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ هُوَ ٱلْبَٰطِلُ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
en: (62) That is because Allāh is the True Reality, and that which they call upon other than Him is falsehood, and because Allāh is the Most High, the Grand.
tr: Dhālika biʾannallāha huwal-ḥaqqu waʾanna mā yadʿūna min dūnihī huwal-bāṭilu waʾannallāha huwal-ʿaliyyul-kabīr

ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَتُصْبِحُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مُخْضَرَّةً إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٌ
en: (63) Do you not see that Allāh has sent down rain from the sky and the earth becomes green? Indeed, Allāh is Subtle[939] and Aware.[940]
enNotes:
[939]- Refer to footnote of 6:103.
[940]- Of His creation and of the needs of His creatures.
tr: Alam tara annallāha anzala minas-samāʾi māʾā, fatuṣbiḥul-arḍu mukhḍarrah, innallāha laṭīfun khabīr

ar: لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
en: (64) To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth. And indeed, Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
tr: Lahū mā fis-samāwāti wamā fil-arḍ, waʾinnallāha lahuwal-ghaniyyul-ḥamīd

ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلْفُلْكَ تَجْرِى فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ بِأَمْرِهِۦ وَيُمْسِكُ ٱلسَّمَآءَ أَن تَقَعَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِٱلنَّاسِ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
en: (65) Do you not see that Allāh has subjected to you whatever is on the earth and the ships which run through the sea by His command? And He restrains the sky from falling upon the earth, unless by His permission. Indeed Allāh, to the people, is Kind and Merciful.
tr: Alam tara annallāha sakhkhara lakum mā fil-arḍi wal-fulka tajrī fil-baḥri biʾamrih, wayumsikus-samāʾa an taqaʿa ʿalal-arḍi illā biʾidhnih, innallāha bin-nāsi laraʾūfur raḥīm

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْيَاكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَكَفُورٌ
en: (66) And He is the one who gave you life; then He causes you to die and then will [again] give you life. Indeed, mankind is ungrateful.
tr: Wahuwal-ladhī aḥyākum, thumma yumītukum thumma yuḥyīkum, innal-insāna lakafūr

ar: لِّكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ جَعَلْنَا مَنسَكًا هُمْ نَاسِكُوهُ فَلَا يُنَٰزِعُنَّكَ فِى ٱلْأَمْرِ وَٱدْعُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ إِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ هُدًى مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
en: (67) For every [religious] community We have appointed rites which they perform. So, [O Muḥammad], let them [i.e., the disbelievers] not contend with you over the matter but invite [them] to your Lord. Indeed, you are upon straight guidance.
tr: Likulli ummatin jaʿalnā mansakan hum nāsikūhu falā yunāziʿunnaka fil-amri wadʿu ilā rabbik, innaka laʿalā hudam mustaqīm

ar: وَإِن جَٰدَلُوكَ فَقُلِ ٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
en: (68) And if they dispute with you, then say, "Allāh is most knowing of what you do.
tr: Waʾin jādalūka faqulillāhu aʿlamu bimā taʿmalūn

ar: ٱللَّهُ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ
en: (69) Allāh will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which you used to differ."
tr: Allāhu yaḥkumu baynakum yawmal-qiyāmati fīmā kuntum fīhi takhtalifūn

ar: أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ فِى كِتَٰبٍ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ
en: (70) Do you not know that Allāh knows what is in the heaven and earth? Indeed, that is in a Record.[941] Indeed that, for Allāh, is easy.
enNotes: [941]- The Preserved Slate (al-Lawḥ al-Maḥfūẓ), which is with Allāh.
tr: Alam taʿlam annallāha yaʿlamu mā fis-samāʾi wal-arḍ, inna dhālika fī kitāb, inna dhālika ʿalallāhi yasīr

ar: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِۦ سُلْطَٰنًا وَمَا لَيْسَ لَهُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ وَمَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٍ
en: (71) And they worship besides Allāh that for which He has not sent down authority and that of which they have no knowledge. And there will not be for the wrongdoers any helper.
tr: Wayaʿbudūna min dūnillāhi mā lam yunazzil bihī sulṭānaw wamā laysa lahum bihī ʿilm, wamā liẓ-ẓālimīna min naṣīr

ar: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍ تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلْمُنكَرَ يَكَادُونَ يَسْطُونَ بِٱلَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا قُلْ أَفَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِشَرٍّ مِّن ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَعَدَهَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
en: (72) And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, you recognize in the faces of those who disbelieve disapproval. They are almost on the verge of assaulting those who recite to them Our verses. Say, "Then shall I inform you of [what is] worse than that?[942] [It is] the Fire which Allāh has promised those who disbelieve, and wretched is the destination."
enNotes: [942]- i.e., worse than the rage you feel against those who recite Allāh's verses or worse than your threats against them.
tr: Waʾidhā tutlā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin taʿrifu fī wujūhil-ladhīna kafarul-munkar, yakādūna yasṭūna bil-ladhīna yatlūna ʿalayhim āyātinā, qul afaʾunabbiʾukum bisharrim min dhālikum, an-nār, waʿadahallāhul-ladhīna kafarū, wabiʾsal-maṣīr

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ضُرِبَ مَثَلٌ فَٱسْتَمِعُوا۟ لَهُۥٓ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَن يَخْلُقُوا۟ ذُبَابًا وَلَوِ ٱجْتَمَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ وَإِن يَسْلُبْهُمُ ٱلذُّبَابُ شَيْـًٔا لَّا يَسْتَنقِذُوهُ مِنْهُ ضَعُفَ ٱلطَّالِبُ وَٱلْمَطْلُوبُ
en: (73) O people, an example is presented, so listen to it. Indeed, those you invoke besides Allāh will never create [as much as] a fly, even if they gathered together for it [i.e., that purpose]. And if the fly should steal from them a [tiny] thing, they could not recover it from him. Weak are the pursuer and pursued.[943]
enNotes: [943]- A comparison is made here to the worshipper of a false deity and that which he worships.
tr: Yā ayyuhan-nāsu ḍuriba mathalun fastamiʿū lah, innal-ladhīna tadʿūna min dūnillāhi lay yakhluqū dhubābaw walawijtamaʿū lah, waʾiy yaslubhumudh-dhubābu shayʾal lā yastanqidhūhu minh, ḍaʿufaṭ-ṭālibu wal-maṭlūb

ar: مَا قَدَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَقَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ
en: (74) They have not appraised Allāh with true appraisal.[944] Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and Exalted in Might.
enNotes: [944]- They have not assessed Him with the assessment due to Him, meaning that they did not take into account His perfect attributes.
tr: Mā qadarullāha ḥaqqa qadrih, innallāha laqawiyyun ʿazīz

ar: ٱللَّهُ يَصْطَفِى مِنَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلًا وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
en: (75) Allāh chooses from the angels messengers and from the people. Indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.
tr: Allāhu yaṣṭafī minal-malāʾikati rusulaw waminan-nās, innallāha samīʿum baṣīr

ar: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
en: (76) He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them.[945] And to Allāh will be returned [all] matters.
enNotes: [945]- See footnote to 20:110.
tr: Yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum, waʾilallāhi turjaʿul-umūr

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ وَٱسْجُدُوا۟ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ وَٱفْعَلُوا۟ ٱلْخَيْرَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
en: (77) O you who have believed, bow and prostrate and worship your Lord and do good - that you may succeed.
tr: Yā ayyuhal-ladhīna āmanurkaʿū wasjudū waʿbudū rabbakum wafʿalul-khayra laʿallakum tufliḥūn

ar: وَجَٰهِدُوا۟ فِى ٱللَّهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهِۦ هُوَ ٱجْتَبَىٰكُمْ وَمَا جَعَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ مِنْ حَرَجٍ مِّلَّةَ أَبِيكُمْ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ هُوَ سَمَّىٰكُمُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ مِن قَبْلُ وَفِى هَٰذَا لِيَكُونَ ٱلرَّسُولُ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْكُمْ وَتَكُونُوا۟ شُهَدَآءَ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ فَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱعْتَصِمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ هُوَ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَوْلَىٰ وَنِعْمَ ٱلنَّصِيرُ
en: (78) And strive for Allāh with the striving due to Him. He has chosen you and has not placed upon you in the religion any difficulty. [It is] the religion of your father, Abraham. He [i.e., Allāh] named you "Muslims" before [in former scriptures] and in this [revelation] that the Messenger may be a witness over you and you may be witnesses over the people. So establish prayer and give zakāh and hold fast to Allāh. He is your protector; and excellent is the protector, and excellent is the helper.
tr: Wajāhidū fillāhi ḥaqqa jihādih, huwajtabākum wamā jaʿala ʿalaykum fid-dīni min ḥaraj, millata abīkum ibrāhīm, huwa sammākumul-muslimīna min qablu wafī hādhā liyakūnar-rasūlu shahīdan ʿalaykum watakūnū shuhadāʾa ʿalan-nās, faʾaqīmuṣ-ṣalāta waʾātuz-zakāta waʿtaṣimū billāh, huwa mawlākum, faniʿmal-mawlā waniʿman-naṣīr
